tidbit: Did you know… about 9,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Google limits Gemini model access to paid users, according to Android Police Confirmed, as the company preps for a public Argon AI launch.
The US-China artificial intelligence performance gap has narrowed to just 3 percent, Confirmed per Mint, with DeepSeek now ranking sixth on LiveBench.
Reported by Chosunbiz: Sam Altman defends artificial intelligence risk tolerance and contrasts OpenAI's approach with Anthropic's push for regulation.
Malaysia plans to table an AI Governance Bill early next year, Reported by DayakDaily, with a risk-based safety framework for coverage of safety and human rights.
OpenAI has fired three employees over an artificial intelligence security breach and paused training of its top artificial intelligence model, Reported by Finanzen100.
Free every hour.
